desc: Remove multiple users from a conversation. Admin version of conversations.kick with support for bulk user removal.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

channel_id.desc: ID of conversation to remove users from.

user_ids.desc: The users to remove from the channel.

removed_user_ids.desc: User IDs that were successfully removed.

failed_user_ids.desc: User IDs that could not be removed, with error details.

error.desc: The error code explaining why the removal failed.

channel_not_found.desc: The value passed for `channel_id` was invalid. It is also returned when the channel belongs to a workspace other than the token's workspace and isn't shared with it.

channel_type_not_supported.desc: The provided `channel_id` is a DM, MPDM, or cannot be used with this method.

external_channel_migrating.desc: The channel is an externally shared channel that is currently being migrated and members can't be removed.

failed_for_all_users.desc: All users could not be removed from the channel. Check `failed_user_ids` for details.

not_supported.desc: This type of channel doesn't support removing members through this method.

restricted_action.desc: The authenticated user lacks channel management permissions for this channel type, or a team preference prevents them from removing members.

permission_denied.desc: The user does not have permission to remove members from the channel.

target_team_not_on_org.desc: The specified target_team is not part of the organization.

failed_for_some_users.desc: Some users could not be removed from the channel. Check `failed_user_ids` for details.
